title: urnetwork / mcp
description: Authenticated MCP service deep dive. Protocol methods and tools come from finite registries; caller-controlled names, identities, URLs, payloads, and errors are never metric labels. Active callers are rolling per-process digest counts and may duplicate across replicas. Fetch results use bounded status, resource, truncation, continuation, and payment classes. Missing or stale telemetry remains no-data.

panels.title: ready instances
panels.description: Migration-aware MCP instances after startup and before drain.

panels.title: draining instances
panels.description: Instances inside the bounded HTTP shutdown lifecycle.

panels.title: authenticated protocol calls / s
panels.description: Parsed MCP calls reaching the finite protocol middleware. HTTP authentication rejections are shown separately.

panels.title: protocol calls in flight
panels.description: Calls currently executing after MCP parsing, by finite method and registered tool.

panels.title: protocol calls by method, tool, and outcome
panels.description: Finite outcomes distinguish succeeded, tool_error, error, canceled, and panic without exporting error text.

panels.title: HTTP authentication and transport outcomes
panels.description: Exact HTTP status and bounded configured-route outcome include OAuth rejection, metadata, malformed traffic, 404/405, panic, abort, and cancel paths.

panels.title: HTTP request and response bytes / s
panels.description: Request bytes are consumed body bytes and response bytes are successfully written body bytes; headers are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP duration mean, p95, p99
panels.description: Whole HTTP handler duration including authentication and protocol encoding. Quantiles are bounded-bucket estimates.

panels.title: MCP call mean duration
panels.description: Rate-derived mean time inside the parsed MCP method pipeline by finite method and tool.

targets.expr: sum by (method, tool) (rate(urnetwork_mcp_call_duration_seconds_sum{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, tool) (rate(urnetwork_mcp_call_duration_seconds_count{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MCP call p95 and p99 duration
panels.description: Fleet histogram quantiles by finite method and registered tool; values are bounded-bucket estimates.

panels.title: fresh one-minute maximum MCP call duration
panels.description: Exact process maxima only while the paired observation timestamp is within 120 seconds; no calls or stale publication remains no-data.

targets.expr: max by (method, tool) (urnetwork_mcp_call_interval_max_seconds{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance, method, tool) (urnetwork_mcp_call_interval_max_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""} > time() - 120 and urnetwork_mcp_call_interval_max_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""} < time() + 30))

panels.title: tool input and output bytes / s
panels.description: Bytes already present in decoded tool inputs and constructed outputs. Results are never serialized solely for metrics.

panels.title: providerLocations output / s
panels.description: Aggregate location items returned by the providerLocations tool, split only by bounded result class.

panels.title: fetch resource outputs / s
panels.description: Fetch output resources by embedded, link, or error item class and bounded terminal result.

panels.title: active authenticated callers (process-local)
panels.description: Rolling distinct authenticated-subject digests per process. Max by window avoids inventing a fleet-distinct total; one caller may reach multiple replicas.

panels.title: fetch concurrency and capacity
panels.description: Global and per-identity active work, configured capacities, and count of retained active identity gates; no identity label is exported.

panels.title: fetch gate waiters and admission outcomes
panels.description: Current waiters and admitted or canceled attempts at the per-identity and global bounded gates.

panels.title: fetch gate wait duration
panels.description: Mean, p95, and p99 time spent at each concurrency gate, including immediate admission and cancellation.

panels.title: fetch result, HTTP status, and continuation classes
panels.description: Bounded fetch outcomes retain HTTP status class plus truncation, continuation, and payment-required state; destinations and error text are never labels.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, status_class, truncated, continuation, payment) (rate(urnetwork_mcp_fetch_results_total{env="$env",service="mcp",block=~"$block",host=~"$host",instance!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HTTP and MCP inflight saturation
panels.description: Whole HTTP requests and parsed protocol calls in flight; the difference includes authentication, parsing, metadata, and encoding work.

panels.title: PostgreSQL pool saturation
panels.description: Used, idle, total, and configured maximum connections for MCP-initialized pools.

panels.title: PostgreSQL acquire and lifecycle pressure
panels.description: Acquire outcomes, wait time, connection creation, and bounded destruction reasons for MCP database work.

panels.title: process CPU, memory, goroutines, and file descriptors
panels.description: MCP process saturation controls by selected deployment block and host.

panels.title: HTTP drain outcomes
panels.description: Last drain duration, handlers active at drain start, and connections hard-cut at deadline. Values appear only after an observed lifecycle.
